title: r1 B2 fix (demo mutation store-threading) has zero test coverage — reverting to the no-op bug keeps all 597 client tests green
evidence: client.gleam:6048 (submit_vacancy demo branch): `True -> { let #(next, eff) = demo_api.create_vacancy(demo_store_of(model), payload, "", ApiReturnedVacancyCreate) #( Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next), vacancy_create_error: Loading,` — same `demo_store: Some(next)` pattern at 1850 (approval), 2570 (mark-opened), 6255/6375 (draft/active save). grep of client/test/ for `UserClickedCreateVacancy|UserClickedSaveVacancyDraft|UserClickedPublishVacancy|UserClickedMarkAllRejected|UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected` in demo mode: zero hits; only demo_flow_test.gleam uses `demo_mode: True`, and its mutation test drives `demo_store.archive_vacancy` directly, not client.update.
detail: r1 blocker B2 (mutations discard store, silent no-ops) is fixed in code but pinned by nothing: no test, no lint. lint_demo_network.py only checks api-call guarding, not store threading. Reintroducing B2 is undetectable.
recommended_fix: Add demo_flow_test cases driving create, draft/active save, and mark-opened through client.update, asserting the mutated store threads back (e.g. new vacancy appears in derived dashboard).

title: Demo boot path (init → is_demo_route → enter_demo → demo_entry_effects) untested — and the gap conceals the un-landed W11 fold (edit deep-link still boots blank)
evidence: demo_entry_effects (client.gleam:5823): arms for `routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard`, `routes.VacancyDetail(id) | routes.VacancyHandoff(id)`, `routes.ApplicationDetail(vid, aid)`, `routes.ArchivedVacancies`, `routes.Comparison(vid)`, then `_ -> []` — no VacancyEdit arm, despite enter_demo setting `vacancy_edit_id: edit_id` with comment "A deep-linked demo edit page needs its id set so the get_for_edit response is accepted and the form can load." No test references enter_demo/is_demo_route (grep: zero hits in client/test/). modem.init does not dispatch at boot, so nothing fires get_for_edit on an edit deep-link.
detail: r1 advisory id 36 demanded a boot-path test; still none. The r2 briefing lists 'edit deep-link boots with its payload' as a landed fold — it did not land, and nothing automated would have caught it.
recommended_fix: Expose is_demo_route/enter_demo (or test via init) and assert per-route entry effects, including a VacancyEdit arm firing demo_api.get_for_edit — then add that arm.

title: demo_requests_are_intercepted_test cannot detect de-interception, and the lint trusts its DEMO_INTERCEPTED allowlist without verifying demo_update — the no-network pillar's pins have a desync blind spot
evidence: Test asserts only Loading: `let #(dash, _) = client.update(m, msg.AppRequestedDashboardData) case dash.vacancies { Loading -> Nil _ -> should.fail() }` — but update_inner's real arm (client.gleam:1479) produces the identical transition: `AppRequestedDashboardData -> { #( Model(..model, vacancies: Loading, dashboard_stats: Loading), vacancy_api.list_vacancies(ApiReturnedDashboardData), ) }` and demo_update.gleam:208 sets the same `vacancies: Loading`. The lint skips allowlisted arms blindly: `if arm_name in EXEMPT_ARMS or arm_name in DEMO_INTERCEPTED: continue` with only the comment "Keep this in sync with the request messages in demo_update.handle — a message listed here must have a demo arm there." Verified by synthetic run: a real `application_api.bulk_reject_applications` call inside a DEMO_INTERCEPTED-listed arm passes the lint with zero demo interception.
detail: Deleting demo_update's bulk-reject or pay/extend arms (exact r1 B3/B4 class) leaves lint green (allowlisted) and tests green (identical Loading transitions, effects discarded). The pillar's pins can't catch interception removal.
recommended_fix: Execute the produced effects in the test (demo effects are synchronous dispatches) asserting fixture responses arrive without network; make the lint mechanically diff DEMO_INTERCEPTED against demo_update's arms.

title: Download effect half of r1 B1 (parse_relative_uri + URL construction + asset presence) remains untested — only the id-mapping is pinned
evidence: report_download_test.gleam tests only the pure mapping: `demo_api.application_id_from_analysis("an-aoife") |> should.equal("a-aoife")`. demo_api.gleam:429-431: "Extracted so the download path is unit-testable (the effect itself is opaque to Node tests)." The untested half includes `case rsvp.parse_relative_uri(url)` and `let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"` — the exact code where r1's second independent bug (relative-URI parse failure) lived.
detail: B1 had two independent bugs; only the mapping regression is pinned. A parse_relative_uri or URL-shape regression fails silently until a landlord clicks download.
recommended_fix: Add a bug-hunt scenario clicking a demo report download and asserting the PDF serves (covers parse, URL shape, and asset presence end-to-end).

title: No /demo bug-hunt E2E scenario exists, yet demo_flow_test's header claims 'The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution'
evidence: demo_flow_test.gleam:11-13: "//// The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution." Enumeration of .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/ (analytics, applications, auth, billing, comparison, dashboard, errors, landing, notifications, settings, ui, vacancies, workflows) contains no demo scenario; grep for 'demo|/demo|v-maples' matches only a comment word in workflows/seed-applicants.yaml.
detail: r1 advisory id 36's third element (a /demo E2E scenario) is unaddressed. The test comment cites effect-execution coverage that does not exist in the repo — misleading for future maintainers.
